input.program:
$dates = {"start":"2026-10-09"}
$sort = {"field":"priceCents","direction":"asc"}
$selectedFareIds = []
$showTimeline = false
calendarQuery = Query("local_query", {"version":1,"sources":[{"datasetRef":"dataset-1hq3nnw","alias":"fares"}],"groupBy":["serviceDate"],"metrics":[{"as":"minimum","op":"min","field":"priceCents"},{"as":"count","op":"count"}],"orderBy":[{"field":"serviceDate","direction":"asc"}],"limit":7})
fareQuery = Query("local_query", {"version":1,"sources":[{"datasetRef":"dataset-1hq3nnw","alias":"fares"}],"where":{"field":"serviceDate","op":"eq","value":$dates.start},"project":["id","originId","destinationId","serviceDate","mode","carrierId","priceCents","durationMinutes","departureMinutes","availableSeats","currency","synthetic","priceBasis","direct"],"orderBy":[{"field":$sort.field,"direction":$sort.direction}],"limit":100})
showMutation = Mutation("patch_artifact_state", {"kind":"runtimeVariables","runtimeVariables":{"$showTimeline":true}})
hideMutation = Mutation("patch_artifact_state", {"kind":"runtimeVariables","runtimeVariables":{"$showTimeline":false}})
hero = TravelHero("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", null, null, null, "London to Paris · 9–15 October 2026")
calendar = PriceCalendar("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Minimum price and fare count by day", null, null, null, null, calendarQuery)
dateControl = DateStrip("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Choose your departure date", null, null, $dates, "dates")
sortControl = SortSelect("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Sort fare choices", null, null, $sort, "sort")
controls = Inline("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", null, null, null, null, null, [dateControl, sortControl])
calendarStory = Section("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", null, null, null, "Find your travel day", null, [calendar, controls])
choices = FarePicker("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Choose a fare for the selected date", null, null, $selectedFareIds, "selectedFareIds", fareQuery)
selected = SelectedItinerary("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Your selection")
summary = StickySummary("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", null, null, null, null, null, [selected])
selectionPane = SplitPane("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", null, null, null, null, null, [choices, summary])
toggle = RetryAction("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", null, null, null, $showTimeline ? "Hide journey timeline" : "Show journey timeline", null, null, null, null, null, $showTimeline ? Action([@Run(hideMutation), @Set($showTimeline, false)]) : Action([@Run(showMutation), @Set($showTimeline, true)]))
timeline = ItineraryTimeline("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Journey timeline", null, null, null, null, fareQuery)
root = TravelSurface("artifact-94a9bc98-5acd-4494-a466-5b98dbc11de5", "dataset-1hq3nnw", null, null, "Calendar-led journey planner", null, [hero, calendarStory, selectionPane, toggle, $showTimeline ? timeline : null])
